notes.title: Announcement: Arctictopia Update
notes.notes:
Thank you for your continued support of our company's work.

We would like to inform you that a game update was implemented on May 30, 2023.

▼ Update Details

Fixed an issue where progress would stop at Level 1 when playing the Mac version.
We appreciate your ongoing support for "Arctictopia" and look forward to serving you in the future.

notes.title: Regarding the issue of progress stucking in Level 1 of the Mac version.
notes.notes:
To players considering purchasing or already considering the Mac version:

We have received reports of an issue in the Mac version where progression is halted at Level 1, and we are currently investigating the cause. Once the cause of the problem is identified, we plan to address it promptly.

For those considering purchasing Polatopia for Mac, please be aware that there is a possibility of progression being halted at Level 1. We kindly ask for your understanding regarding this matter, and we will provide further updates on the progress of the investigation.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your patience while we work towards resolving this issue.

notes.title: Version Update
notes.notes:
Dear Users,

We would like to thank everyone for their support of "Arctictopia"

We have just released the latest version, which fixes the issue that Steam achievements not being automatically unlocked.

The updates are as follows.

・Fixed a bug that Steam Achievements not being automatically unlocked when playing the game.
※Please note that after the game is updated, all Steam Achievements will be automatically unlocked, 
and some achievements will have to be completed again in-game.


We are keen to provide the best "Arctictopia" to you, so please let us know if you have any other feedback.
